hebrewText: וּ/מַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/עָ֨רְפְּ/כֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד

tokens.bdb: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy
tokens.kjv: circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, [idiom] must needs.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: the heart (as the most interior organ);
tokens.kjv: [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.

tokens.bdb: the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the nape or back of the neck ; hence
tokens.enLiteralWord: the nape or back of the neck ; hence
tokens.explanation: the nape or back of the neck ; hence
tokens.explanationEn: the nape or back of the neck ; hence

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: properly, to be dense, i.e. tough or severe (in various applications)
tokens.kjv: be cruel, be fiercer, make grievous, be ((ask a), be in, have, seem, would) hard(-en, (labour), -ly, thing), be sore, (be, make) stiff(-en, (-necked)).

tokens.bdb: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
tokens.kjv: again, [idiom] all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), [idiom] once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).
